'''Cris Tosiren''', known to most of his associates as '''Sot-sirc''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was born in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] about forty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Tosiren had few memories of his parents and from a young age, he was forced to carry out work for [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], [[Spice/Legends|spice]] runners and religious cultists in order to survive, engaging in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and acts of theft. He began cultivating relationships with a variety of individuals, to provide himself with sources of information, and he began wearing prosthetics in order to disguise his physical appearance.

During the Clone Wars, the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] user [[Ins1dr]] posted a message on the HoloNet, claiming that Sot-sirc had previously helped the criminal [[Len Markus]] to locate the [[Darkstaff]], a powerful, ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that Markus discovered in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Ins1dr also claimed that Sot-sirc had recently returned to the Cularin system.
